children: 回顾一下，对自由兑换为商品货币条件下竞争性银行体系创造的信用货币而言，存在两个作用于其（内生）创造数量的外部限制因素。第一，被动地，可兑换性的简单存在阻止相对于商品货币的系统性升水与贴水出现。第二，主动地，保卫银行持有的商品货币准备、尤其是银行体系集中准备的要求，会诱发必然导致价格下降的行动。对两者而言，商品货币内在价值提供的锚，通过信用货币数量与产出水平两者持续且往往剧烈的调整运作。货币数量论对这一过程没有解释力。

To recap, for credit money created by a competitive banking system under conditions of free convertibility into commodity money, there would be two external limiting factors operating on its (endogenously) created quantity. First, and passively, the simple existence of convertibility would prevent the emergence of systematic premia and discounts relative to commodity money. Second, and actively, the requirement to defend the reserves of commodity money held by banks and, above all, of the centralised reserve of the banking system would induce necessitate actions that would lead to price falls. For both, the anchor that would be provided by the intrinsic value of commodity money would operate through constant, and often violent, adjustment of both the quantity of credit money and the level of output. The quantity theory of money would have no explanatory power over this process.

body.review: 原文“would induce necessitate actions”两动词叠用，疑衍其一。

children: 现在考虑竞争性银行体系创造的信用货币，该体系没有义务将其负债兑换为商品货币，也不持有银行黄金准备。大体而言，这样的条件在二十世纪过程中逐渐出现，并在布雷顿森林体系崩溃后的四十年间占主导。清楚的是，这些条件的出现需要国家行动，包括正式禁止信用货币兑换为商品货币。一旦这些条件就位，商品货币的货币角色就缩减为形成一个基本上休眠的国家贮藏——即最后价值准备。

Consider now credit money created by a competitive banking system which would be under no obligation to exchange its liabilities for commodity money, and which would keep no banking reserves of gold. Broadly speaking, such conditions have emerged gradually in the course of the twentieth century, and have become prevalent during the four decades following the collapse of the Bretton Woods system. It is clear that for these conditions to emerge, state action would be necessary, including a formal ban on converting credit money into commodity money. Once these conditions would be in place, the monetary role of commodity money would be reduced to forming a national hoard that would remain largely dormant – i.e. a value reserve of last resort.
然而，商品货币实际上缺席货币领域，并不会改变信用货币数量通过银行贷款的发放与偿还——即通过发行与回流——创造这一事实。信用货币的创造仍内生于资本积累过程。没有理由认为先前关于货币数量与产出数量共同决定、从而信用货币交换价值决定中的不确定性的分析结果会有任何不同。

The effective absence of commodity money from the monetary, however, would not alter the fact that the quantity of credit money would be created through the advance and repayment of banks loans – i.e. through issue and reflux. Credit money creation would remain endogenous to the process of capital accumulation. There would be no reason why the earlier analytical results regarding the joint determination of the quantity of money and the quantity of output, hence the uncertainty in determining the exchange value of credit money, would be at all different.

body.review: 原文“absence of commodity money from the monetary”中“monetary”后疑脱“sphere”一类词。

children: 然而，不同的是信用货币交换价值向商品货币内在价值的锚定。将不存在锚定。商品货币的被动（可兑换性）与主动（银行准备）限制角色都被排除。在这种条件下，货币数量论（先前与信用货币无关）获得某种相关性。由于不能保证银行体系运作创造的信用货币数量与商品产出协调，货币与产出两者数量的变化可能引起信用货币交换价值的永久性变化。

What would be different, however, would be the anchoring of the exchange value of credit money onto the intrinsic value of commodity money. There would be none. Both the passive (convertibility) and the active (bank reserves) limiting roles of commodity money would be precluded. Under such conditions, the quantity theory of money (which was previously irrelevant for credit money) would acquire some relevance. Since there could be no guarantee that the quantity of credit money created through the operations of the banking system would be in harmony with commodity output, it would be possible to have permanent changes in the exchange value of credit money from changes in the quantities of both money and output.
还值得注意的是，这一结果在分析上不同于先前法定货币的结果，尽管货币数量论在两种场合都成立。因为不可兑换信用货币交换价值发生的变化，不等价于单位无价值货币对商品货币符号化比率的变化。相反，它们只是反映货币对商品的单纯比率的变化——在这方面纯粹货币数量论成立。

It is also worth noting that this result is not analytically identical to the earlier one for fiat money, even though the quantity theory of money would hold on both occasions. For the changes that would occur in the exchange value of inconvertible credit money would not be equivalent to changes in the rate of symbolisation of commodity money by a unit of valueless money. Rather, they would simply reflect changes in the plain ratio of money to commodities – a pure quantity theory of money would hold in this respect.
另一方面，商品货币准备的缺失会显著增加货币当局有意识操纵银行运作的空间，从而也增加操纵信用货币数量的空间。如果银行体系的准备与一种生产出来的商品无关、并最终依托国家信用，货币当局就有相当大的自由创造准备并影响信用货币的创造。在没有黄金的情况下，关于利息率的相机抉择政策获得若干自由度，而保卫国家黄金贮藏之需要的解除又进一步增加这些自由度。

On the other hand, the absence of reserves of commodity money would significantly increase the room for conscious manipulation of banking operations by the monetary authorities, hence also the room to manipulate the quantity of credit money. If the reserves of the banking system were unrelated to a produced commodity and ultimately rested on state credit, the monetary authorities would have considerable freedom to create reserves and to influence the creation of credit money. In the absence of gold, discretionary policy with regard to the rate of interest would acquire several degrees of freedom, further increased by the lifting of the need to defend the national gold hoard.
只要中央银行能在危机时期生成可接受的硬通货、并提供足够数量的流动性以缓和资本重组过程，它们就能限制萧条期价格下降的程度。商品货币的内在价值不再为信用货币的交换价值提供参照点。有意识操纵价格水平的空间相应增加，从而增强中央银行与一般国家的角色。

As long as central banks could generate acceptable hard cash in times of crisis and sufficient quantities of liquidity to ease the process of capital restructuring, they would be able to limit the extent to which prices would fall in a slump. The intrinsic value of commodity money would cease to provide a reference point for the exchange value of credit money. The scope for conscious manipulation of the price level would be correspondingly increased, thus enhancing the role of the central bank and of the state in general.
回顾一下，没有义务将其负债兑换为货币商品的竞争性信用体系所创造的信用货币，其交换价值在商品货币的内在价值中没有锚。信用货币的数量仍内生决定，但可受国家当局操纵。在这种条件下，纯粹货币数量论与信用货币交换价值的决定相关。

To recap, credit money created by a competitive credit system which has no obligation to convert its liabilities into the money commodity, would not have an anchor for its exchange value in the intrinsic value of commodity money. The quantity of credit money would remain endogenously determined, but it would be amenable to manipulation by state authorities. Under such conditions, a pure quantity theory of money would be relevant to determining of the exchange value of credit money.

商品货币、特别是马克思的一般等价物理论，是分析无价值货币的坚实基础。商品货币是一种基本的、但也是初级的货币形式；在执行其职能时，它发展为更高级的、通常无价值的货币形式。货币发展的关键，是每种货币形式对它在资本主义交换中被要求执行的职能的适当性。于是，国家发行的法定货币主要是流通手段，而银行发行的信用货币倾向于成为支付手段与贮藏要素。无价值货币形式的出现对货币交换价值的决定具有深远含义，这一过程对商品货币、法定货币与信用货币分别相当不同，尤其就影响各自数量的因素而言。商品货币的数量由贮藏调节；法定货币的数量取决于国家的任意行动；信用货币的数量由信用过程调节。

Commodity money and, in particular, Marx’s theory of the universal equivalent are firm foundations for the analysis of valueless money. Commodity money is a fundamental, but also elementary, form of money; in performing its functions, it develops into more advanced and typically valueless forms of money. The key to the development of money is the adequacy of each form of money for the functions which it is called to perform in capitalist exchange. Thus, state-issued fiat money is primarily a means of circulation, while bank-issued credit money tends to be a means of payment and hoard element. The emergence of valueless forms of money has profound implications for determining the exchange value of money, a process that is quite distinct for commodity, fiat, and credit money, respectively, particularly with regard to the factors influencing the quantity of each. The quantity of commodity money is regulated by hoarding; the quantity of fiat money depends on arbitrary state action; the quantity of credit money is regulated by credit processes.

货币商品的内在价值密切调节商品货币的交换价值，但对不可兑换法定货币的交换价值不起锚定作用。据此，货币数量论与前者无关，但对后者有解释力。另一方面，商品货币内在价值与信用货币交换价值之间的关系取决于制度安排。如果信用货币可兑换为商品货币、且后者也充当银行准备，商品货币的内在价值就通过可兑换性与银行准备纪律锚定信用货币的交换价值。货币数量论与这一过程无关。另一方面，如果信用货币不可兑换为商品货币、且后者在货币体系中没有活跃准备，信用货币的交换价值就不会锚定于商品货币。货币数量论对这种货币的交换价值具有某种解释力。

The intrinsic value of the money commodity closely regulates the exchange value of commodity money, but plays no anchoring role for the exchange value of inconvertible fiat money. By this token, the quantity theory of money is irrelevant to the former, but has explanatory power over the latter. The relation between the intrinsic value of commodity money and the exchange value of credit money, on the other hand, depends on institutional arrangements. If credit money were convertible into commodity money, which also acted as bank reserve, the intrinsic value of commodity money would anchor the exchange value of credit money through convertibility and bank reserve discipline. The quantity theory of money would have no relevance to this process. If, on the other hand, credit money were inconvertible into commodity money and the latter had no active reserve in the monetary system, there would be no anchoring of the exchange value of credit money onto commodity money. The quantity theory of money would have some explanatory power over the exchange value of such money.
